calendar.title: Calendar
calendar.comingTitle: Calendar views are on their way
calendar.comingText: Month, week, day and agenda views arrive with the next update. Your calendars are already listed in the sidebar.

groups.title: Groups
groups.description: Clubs, teams and families you share calendars with.
groups.comingText: Soon you can create groups, invite members by email or link and manage roles here.

invite.title: You're invited
invite.description: Join the group to see and edit its shared calendars.
invite.signInFirst: Sign in or create an account to accept the invitation.
invite.invalidText: This invitation link is incomplete. Ask for a new link.

settings.description: Manage your profile and how you sign in.

profile.title: Profile
profile.description: How others see you and how dates and times are shown to you.
profile.timeZoneHint: Event times are shown in this time zone.

security.title: Security
security.twoFactorDescription: Protect your account with a code from an authenticator app in addition to your password.
security.offText: Use an authenticator app such as 2FAS, Aegis, Google Authenticator or 1Password.
security.verifyFirst: Confirm your email address before turning on two-factor authentication.
security.step1: 1. Scan the QR code with your authenticator app
security.qrLabel: QR code for your authenticator app
security.manualKey: Can't scan it? Enter this key manually:
security.step2: 2. Enter the 6-digit code from the app and your password
security.disableText: Your account will be protected by your password only. Confirm with your password or a current code.
security.regenerateText: Your current recovery codes stop working. Confirm with your password or a current code.
security.recoveryLeft: No recovery codes left | One recovery code left | {n} recovery codes left
security.recoveryLow: You're running out of recovery codes. Create new ones so you don't get locked out.
security.recoveryFileHeader: sCalenderPlus recovery codes. Each code works once. Keep them somewhere safe.
security.codesText: If you lose your phone, each of these codes lets you sign in once. They are shown only now.

auth.passwordHint: At least {min} characters. A passphrase of a few words works well.
auth.sessionEnded: Your session has ended. Please sign in again.

login.title: Sign in
login.description: Welcome back. Sign in to your calendars.
login.secondFactorExpired: The sign-in took too long. Please enter your password again.

twoFactor.title: Two-factor authentication
twoFactor.description: Enter the 6-digit code from your authenticator app.
twoFactor.recoveryDescription: Enter one of the recovery codes you saved when you set up two-factor authentication.

register.title: Create your account
register.description: Share calendars with per-event permissions. Free to start.
register.doneText: We sent a confirmation link to {email}. Open it to confirm your address.
register.doneHint: You can already sign in. Didn't get an email? Check your spam folder or request a new link after signing in.

forgot.title: Reset your password
forgot.description: Enter your email address and we'll send you a link to choose a new password.
forgot.doneText: If an account exists for {email}, you'll receive a link to reset your password. The link is valid for one day.

reset.title: Choose a new password
reset.description: Your new password signs you out on all other devices.
reset.doneText: You can now sign in with your new password.
reset.invalidText: The reset link is invalid, expired or was already used. Request a new one.

verify.title: Confirm email address
verify.doneText: Thanks! You can now invite others and accept invitations.
verify.invalidText: The confirmation link is invalid, expired or was already used.
verify.errorTitle: We couldn't confirm your email address
